applyHint: Writing a value applies it on the node immediately. Use "Save to node" so it survives a restart.
applyHintRestart: Some of your changes only take effect after the node restarts. Write, then "Save to node", then restart it.

bus-off.hint: The CAN controller went bus-off: the bus is electrically faulty. Check for shorted or loose CAN_H/CAN_L, a missing ground, or missing termination.
bus-off.title: Bus errors

idle.hint: Nothing is being sent or received on this bus. Check that a CAN port uses DroneCAN and that the flight controller was rebooted after changing CAN settings.
idle.title: No traffic

no-ack.hint: The flight controller sends frames but no device acknowledges them. Check the cable (CAN_H and CAN_L not swapped), that the device is powered, that both ends are terminated with 120 Ω (most autopilots have one built in), and that the bitrate matches the device (DroneCAN default is 1 Mbit/s).
no-ack.title: Nothing answers on the bus

rx-errors.hint: Frames arrive damaged or are dropped. Check termination, cable length and the bitrate on every device.
rx-errors.title: Receive errors

busHealth.subtitle: CAN{{port}} as the flight controller sees it, measured every 5 s
busHealth.title: Bus health
busHealth.unavailable: This firmware does not report CAN statistics (needs MAVLink FTP and @SYS/can0_stats.txt).

dangerTip: A wrong value can drop this node off the CAN bus or overwrite its bootloader. Recovering it then needs a USB or SLCAN connection to the node.
docsSource: Descriptions from the ArduPilot AP_Periph documentation

error.failed: The flight controller refused CAN forwarding for this port.
error.noResponse: No answer from the flight controller. Check that the port's driver is enabled and the FC was rebooted after changing CAN settings.
error.unsupported: This firmware build has no CAN forwarding over MAVLink, so ArduDeck cannot see the DroneCAN bus.

fcHint: This is the flight controller itself. Its settings are in the regular parameter table.
framesTip: CAN frames received from the bus while this tab is open

noBus.body: No CAN port uses the DroneCAN protocol. Set CAN_P1_DRIVER to 1 and CAN_D1_PROTOCOL to DroneCAN, then reboot the flight controller.
noBus.title: No DroneCAN bus configured

rebootTip: Takes effect after the node restarts.
restarted: Restart sent. The node reappears in a few seconds.

review.saveOnNode: Also save on the node, so the values survive a restart
review.title: Review DroneCAN changes

saveToNodeTip: Store the current values in the node's flash so they survive a restart
stoppedHint: Monitoring is stopped. Press Start to read the bus.
subtitle: Devices on the CAN bus, read through the flight controller
title: DroneCAN
waitingForNodes: Listening on the bus. Nodes appear within a second of sending their status.
writtenAndSaved_one: {{count}} value written and saved on the node.
writtenAndSaved_other: {{count}} values written and saved on the node.
